title: Invariant principal-bundle connections for arbitrary Lie-group automorphism actions classified by compatible maps on transverse covering patches
author: Maximilian Hanusch
difficulty_reason: The proof reconstructs an invariant connection from data on patches crossing possibly nontransitive orbits without requiring a smooth orbit space or constant stabilizer type. It proves independence of the orbit representative and patch, descends the local tangent maps through their kernels and establishes smoothness through transverse local action diffeomorphisms.
source_version: Official SIGMA 10 (2014) article 025, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2014.025; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Complete Theorem4.9 reduction/reconstruction chain Lemma4.1, Corollary4.2, Lemma4.7 and Proposition4.8 read, with the action-patch definitions and transversality construction in Section3. A Phi-covering consists of Theta-patches whose projections meet every base orbit, for Theta on Q=G times S. Reduced maps are smooth and linear on g plus each patch tangent space and satisfy both exact compatibility conditions of Corollary4.2. The construction is the source formula(4.5), with explicit representative independence and local smoothness proof. No transitivity/properness assumption or example classification is added.

statement_scope: Full Theorem4.9 for a smooth Lie-group action by principal-bundle automorphisms on(P,pi,M,S), with any Phi-covering as defined in Section3. Invariant smooth connection forms correspond bijectively to the reduced smooth linear maps g times T P_alpha ->s satisfying Corollary4.2(i)-(ii). No claim for arbitrary nontransverse slices.
editorial_warning: Lemma4.7(3) prints the kernel containment in the reverse direction to the zero-tangent compatibility explicitly stated in Remark4.4(a). The author reconstruction(4.4) uses the latter explicit zero-tangent relation. Both are included unchanged; no source formula is replaced.
source_boundary_note: Full original Theorem 4.9 is retained with its entire new reduction/reconstruction and transverse-action-patch proof, including the explicit local tangent forms, representative and patch independence, descended connection formula and local smoothness argument. Reduced maps obey both exact Corollary 4.2 compatibility conditions. The general smooth principal-bundle automorphism action need not be transitive, proper or have constant stabilizer type. The short assembly sentence combines the bundled genuinely new nontransitive reconstruction core. Original reverse kernel-containment symbol and its explicit zero-tangent condition are preserved with the existing source notice. No gauge-fixing example, orbit-type specialization or loop-quantum-gravity application is selected.
